requirements.text: Default panels and their contents shall be loaded in Sidebar.
Maximum width of Sidebar shall be be approximately one third of the browser window size.
Non-default width of Sidebar shall retain after new window is opened or browser is restarted.
Mouse cursors shall display the right icon when mousing over.
Panels shall appear highlighted when mouse is moved over them.
Sidebar shall be opened / closed with grippy.
A panel shall be added to the sidebar.
An already added panel shall not be added to the sidebar.
A panel shall be deleted from the sidebar.
All panels shall be deleted from the sidebar.
All remote panels shall be listed.
All local panels shall be listed.
The panels shall be previewed before addition.
The panels shall be customized on the sidebar.
The panels shall be reordered on the sidebar.
Nothing shall change after adding / reordering panels on the sidebar when cancelled.
The changes in order and panel list shall be reflected when saved.
The links in What's Related panels shall be opened in the browser.
The links in Bookmarks panel shall be opened in the browser.
The panel title shall show up in Add menu when panel is added.
Unselecting panels from Add menu shall remove panels from the Sidebar.
A panel shall be added to the sidebar using javascript.

generated_cases.title: Load default panels and contents
generated_cases.description: Verify that default panels and their contents are successfully loaded in the sidebar.

generated_cases.title: Sidebar maximum width boundary
generated_cases.description: Verify that the maximum width of the sidebar does not exceed approximately one third of the browser window size.

generated_cases.title: Retain non-default width across restart and new window
generated_cases.description: Verify that a non-default width of the sidebar is retained after a new window is opened or the browser is restarted.

generated_cases.title: Mouse cursor icon display on hover
generated_cases.description: Verify that mouse cursors display the correct icon when mousing over sidebar elements.

generated_cases.title: Panel highlight on mouse over
generated_cases.description: Verify that panels appear highlighted when the mouse is moved over them.

generated_cases.title: Open and close sidebar with grippy
generated_cases.description: Verify that the sidebar can be successfully opened and closed using the grippy.

generated_cases.title: Add a new panel to the sidebar
generated_cases.description: Verify that a new panel can be successfully added to the sidebar.

generated_cases.title: Prevent duplicate panel addition
generated_cases.description: Verify that an already added panel cannot be added again to the sidebar.

generated_cases.title: Delete a single panel from the sidebar
generated_cases.description: Verify that a specific panel can be deleted from the sidebar.

generated_cases.title: Delete all panels from the sidebar
generated_cases.description: Verify that all panels can be deleted simultaneously from the sidebar.

generated_cases.title: List all remote panels
generated_cases.description: Verify that all remote panels are correctly listed.

generated_cases.title: List all local panels
generated_cases.description: Verify that all local panels are correctly listed.

generated_cases.title: Preview panels before addition
generated_cases.description: Verify that panels are correctly previewed prior to being added.

generated_cases.title: Customize panels on the sidebar
generated_cases.description: Verify that panels can be customized on the sidebar.

generated_cases.title: Reorder panels on the sidebar
generated_cases.description: Verify that panels can be reordered on the sidebar.

generated_cases.title: Cancel changes during adding or reordering panels
generated_cases.description: Verify that nothing changes after adding or reordering panels on the sidebar when the operation is cancelled.

generated_cases.title: Save changes in order and panel list
generated_cases.description: Verify that changes in order and panel list are correctly reflected when saved.

generated_cases.title: Open links in What's Related panels
generated_cases.description: Verify that links in What's Related panels are opened in the browser.

generated_cases.title: Open links in Bookmarks panel
generated_cases.description: Verify that links in the Bookmarks panel are opened in the browser.

generated_cases.title: Panel title visibility in Add menu
generated_cases.description: Verify that the panel title shows up in the Add menu when a panel is added.

generated_cases.title: Unselect panels from Add menu
generated_cases.description: Verify that unselecting panels from the Add menu removes panels from the sidebar.

generated_cases.title: Add a panel using javascript
generated_cases.description: Verify that a panel can be successfully added to the sidebar using javascript.

generated_cases.title: Sidebar Width at Approximately One Third Limit
generated_cases.description: Test sidebar width set exactly at, just inside, and just outside approximately one third of the browser window size.

generated_cases.title: Add Panel Boundary Condition for Duplicate Panels
generated_cases.description: Test adding a panel that is not yet added (valid) versus adding a panel that is already added (boundary limit where duplicate addition is prevented).

generated_cases.title: Panel Deletion Limits from Sidebar
generated_cases.description: Test deleting a single panel versus deleting all panels from the sidebar to verify empty state boundaries.

generated_cases.title: Sidebar Customization Action Boundaries (Cancel vs Save)
generated_cases.description: Test boundaries of saving versus cancelling changes made to panel additions, reordering, and lists to ensure state persistence or reversion.

generated_cases.title: Open and Close Sidebar with Grippy
generated_cases.description: Verify that the sidebar is successfully opened and closed using the grippy transition event.

generated_cases.title: Add New Panel to Sidebar
generated_cases.description: Verify the normal state transition of adding a new panel to the sidebar.

generated_cases.title: Forbidden Addition of Existing Panel
generated_cases.description: Verify the abnormal state transition where an already added panel cannot be added again to the sidebar.

generated_cases.title: Delete Panel from Sidebar
generated_cases.description: Verify the state transition of deleting a specific panel from the sidebar.

generated_cases.title: Delete All Panels from Sidebar
generated_cases.description: Verify the state transition of deleting all panels from the sidebar simultaneously.

generated_cases.title: Cancel Changes During Panel Addition and Reordering
generated_cases.description: Verify that cancelling the addition or reordering of panels results in no state changes on the sidebar.

generated_cases.title: Save Changes in Panel Order and List
generated_cases.description: Verify the state transition where changes in order and panel list are successfully reflected upon saving.

generated_cases.title: Remove Panels via Add Menu Unselection
generated_cases.description: Verify the state transition where unselecting panels from the Add menu removes the corresponding panels from the sidebar.

generated_cases.title: Default panels loading and width constraints
generated_cases.description: Verify that default panels load in the sidebar and that the maximum width adheres to approximately one third of the browser window size.

generated_cases.title: Retaining non-default sidebar width across sessions
generated_cases.description: Verify that a non-default width of the sidebar is successfully retained after opening a new window or restarting the browser.

generated_cases.title: Mouse cursor and panel highlight behaviors
generated_cases.description: Verify that mouse cursors display the correct icon and panels appear highlighted when the mouse is moved over them.

generated_cases.title: Toggle sidebar using grippy
generated_cases.description: Verify that the sidebar can be properly opened and closed using the grippy control.

generated_cases.title: Adding a new panel vs duplicate panel restriction
generated_cases.description: Verify that a new panel can be added to the sidebar, but an already added panel is restricted and cannot be added again.

generated_cases.title: Deleting individual and all panels
generated_cases.description: Verify that a single panel can be deleted from the sidebar, and alternatively all panels can be deleted.

generated_cases.title: Listing remote and local panels
generated_cases.description: Verify that all remote panels and all local panels are correctly listed.

generated_cases.title: Panel preview, customization, and reordering
generated_cases.description: Verify that panels can be previewed before addition, customized on the sidebar, and reordered.

generated_cases.title: Cancellation versus saving of panel additions and reordering
generated_cases.description: Verify that cancelling changes leaves nothing changed, whereas saving correctly reflects the changes in order and panel list.

generated_cases.title: Opening links from panels and managing via Add menu
generated_cases.description: Verify that links in What's Related and Bookmarks panels open in the browser, and unselecting panels from the Add menu removes them from the sidebar.

generated_cases.title: Default Sidebar Initialization and Width Constraints
generated_cases.description: Verify that default panels and their contents load properly, the maximum width respects approximately one third of the browser window, and custom widths are retained across restarts and new windows.

generated_cases.title: Sidebar Hover and Toggle Interaction
generated_cases.description: Verify that mouse cursors display the correct icon and panels appear highlighted on mouseover, and that the sidebar can be successfully opened and closed using the grippy.

generated_cases.title: Panel Addition, Preview, and Duplicate Prevention Workflow
generated_cases.description: Verify the end-to-end user flow of previewing panels, listing local and remote panels, adding a new panel, verifying its title in the Add menu, and ensuring that attempting to add an already added panel is prevented.

generated_cases.title: Panel Deletion Workflow
generated_cases.description: Verify that individual panels can be deleted, all panels can be deleted simultaneously, and unselecting panels from the Add menu removes them from the Sidebar.

generated_cases.title: Panel Customization, Reordering, and Cancellation
generated_cases.description: Verify that panels can be customized and reordered, that saving these changes correctly reflects the new order and panel list, and that cancelling leaves everything unchanged.

generated_cases.title: Link Navigation from Sidebar Panels
generated_cases.description: Verify that links contained within What's Related panels and Bookmarks panels correctly open in the browser.

generated_cases.title: Programmatic Panel Addition via JavaScript
generated_cases.description: Verify that a panel can be successfully added to the sidebar using javascript.

generated_cases.title: Duplicate Panel Addition Misuse
generated_cases.description: Attempt to add an already existing panel to the sidebar to verify it is not added again.

generated_cases.title: Sidebar Width Persistence Extreme Resize
generated_cases.description: Resize sidebar beyond the maximum allowed approximately one third of the browser window size and check if non-default width retains after browser restart.

generated_cases.title: Cancel Action State Preservation
generated_cases.description: Modify panel order and list, then trigger cancellation to ensure no changes are applied.

generated_cases.title: Add Menu Unselection Sync
generated_cases.description: Unselect panels directly from the Add menu to verify they are properly removed from the Sidebar.

generated_cases.title: Malformed JavaScript Panel Addition
generated_cases.description: Attempt to add a panel using malformed or malicious javascript to test failure handling.

reference_cases.title: TC-144
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. In the Sidebar, verify that the following default panels appear:
*Search
*Buddy List
*Stocks
*News (open)
Shopping
Today's Tips
Bookmarks
3. Also verify the content in each default panel appears by selecting them one by one
*: Default open panels.

EXPECTED RESULTS
All the default panels listed above should appear in the Sidebar and their content should be proper.

reference_cases.title: TC-145
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. Click with the mouse on the Sidebar grippy (mouse pressed) and expand the sidebar
3. Observe that the width of the Sidebar expands
4. The maximum that the Sidebar should expand should be approx 1/3rd of the browser window size

EXPECTED RESULTS
Sidebar max width should be correct

reference_cases.title: TC-146
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. Click with the mouse on the Sidebar grippy(mouse pressed) and expand the sidebar
3. Make the width of the Sidebar to whatever you want (upto max allowed)
4. Select File| New Navigator Window to open a new browser window
5. Observe that the Sidebar width should be the same as in the earlier window and should not appear changed
6. Also, after step3, select File|Quit to close the browser
7. Restart the browser

EXPECTED RESULTS
After step 3 and step 6, sidebar non-default width should be the same as changed earlier

reference_cases.title: TC-147
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. From the Sidebar, click on any of the default panel,say, CNN.com and open it
3. Moving the mouse over the links in the panel should change the mouse icon thus making the user understand that the text is clickable
4. Moving the mouse over plain html text should also change the mouse icon
5. Moving the mouse away from the clickable text(to a blank space) should change the mouse icon again

EXPECTED RESULTS
Mouse icons should change properly

reference_cases.title: TC-148
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
This test works only with the "Classic" Theme set for the browser.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. Move the mouse on any of the panels in the Sidebar
3. Each panel should highlight making itself visible when the mouse is over it

EXPECTED RESULTS
Panels should highlight when mouse is moved over them

reference_cases.title: TC-149
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. Point and click with the mouse on te grippy at the center of the Sidebar border
3. Clicking once should close the sidebar
4. Again, point with the mouse on the grippy on the left border of the browser window and click the mouse
5. This should open the Sidebar with the original width

EXPECTED RESULTS
Sidebar should open/close properly with grippy

reference_cases.title: TC-150
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
This test works only with the "Classic" Theme set for the browser.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. From the sidebar, select "Tabs | Customize Sidebar"
3. From the window titled 'Customize Sidebar', select any panel from any of the folders available and click on the 'Tabs' button to add the panel to the sidebar.
4. Press OK to close the window.

EXPECTED RESULTS
After step 2, the seleced panel should get added to the pane titled "My Sidebar". Pressing the OK button in step3 should close the "Customize Sidebar" window and the newly added panel should appear at the bottom of the Sidebar in the navigator window.

reference_cases.title: TC-151
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. From the sidebar, select "Tabs | Customize Sidebar"
3. From the window that opens up, select "What's Related" or "Search" (already added panels) and click on "Add" button.

EXPECTED RESULTS
After step 2, the panel should only be highlighted in the right pane and should not get added again to the list.

reference_cases.title: TC-152
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. From the sidebar, select "Tabs | Customize Sidebar"
3. From the window that opens up, from the pane titled "My Sidebar", click on any panel that has been already added
4. Click on "Remove" button to remove the panel
5. Press "OK" to close the window

EXPECTED RESULTS
After step 3, the selected panel should be removed from the list in the right pane. After step 4, the panel that was removed should no longer be listed in the Sidebar.

reference_cases.title: TC-153
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. From the Sidebar , select "Tabs | Customize Sidebar"
3. From the window that opens up, from the pane titled "My Sidebar", click with the mouse on the bottommost panel
4. Click on "Remove" button once for each panel to remove all the panels
5. Press "OK" to close the window

EXPECTED RESULTS
After step 4, the pane on the right should be blank. After step 5, no panels should be listed in the Sidebar and a mesage saying "The Sidebar is currently empty.....and select Sidebar" should appear.

reference_cases.title: TC-154
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. From the Sidebar, select "Tabs | Customize Sidebar"
3. From the window that opens up, the pane titled "AvailablePanels" should list the following folders by default: Favorites, From Netscape, From Others, International.
4. Click and open each folder mentioned above to see that they are not empty and that a listing of panels is available in each folder
5. Verify that the Favourites folder lists these panels: CNN.com, Horoscope, Mozillazine, News, Stocks, Tech News, Weather
6. Verify that the From Netscape folder lists these panels: Calender, Horoscopes, Local Events, Local Movies, Local News, News, Sports, Stocks, Tech News, Weather
7. Verify that the From Others folder lists these panels: BackFlip Buddy, CNET.com, CNN.com, eBay, Kinderview, Mapquest, Mozillazine, Red Herring, Webstakes.com and the folder My Netscape Network
8. The International folder should list the following folders: Brazil, Canada, France, Germany, Japan, Portugal, Spain, Sweden, UK

EXPECTED RESULTS
All default remote panels should be available

reference_cases.title: TC-155
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. From the Sidebar , select "Tabs | Customize Sidebar"
3. From the window that opens up, the pane titled "AvailablePanels" should list the following local panels by default: What's Related, Search, Bookmarks

EXPECTED RESULTS
All default local panels should be available

reference_cases.title: TC-156
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. From the Sidebar, select "Tabs | Customize Sidebar"
3. From the window that opens up, select and click on any panel from the panel titled "Available Panels"
4. The "Preview..." button should be highlighted
5. Clicking on the "Preview..." button should open up a window titled "Panel Preview" and showing how the panel looks
6. Pressing the "x" button on top right of the window should close the preview window

EXPECTED RESULTS
Panels can be previewed

reference_cases.title: TC-157
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. From the Sidebar, select "Tabs | Customize Sidebar"
3. From the window that opens up, select and click on a panel, say, Stocks and press the Add button to add the panel to the Sidebar
4. Highlight the Stocks panel from the right pane titled "My Sidebar" and click on the "Customize Panel..." button
5. A Netscape Registration window should open up
6. If you already have a netcenter username, press the "Sign in" button else fill the form details and press "Next"
7. Proceed with the registration. A "Welcome" window giving you options to customize your page will open up
8. Clicking on "Build My Page!" button should open a browser window showing all panels for your customized webpage
9. From the "Stocks" window, clicking on the "smiling face" icon should open a customize window for Stocks
10. Add a few stocks to your portfolio and make any changes
11. Click on the "Save" button to clsoe the window

EXPECTED RESULTS
All your customized changes should be visible in the panel in the Sidebar

reference_cases.title: TC-158
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. From the Sidebar , select "Tabs | Customize Sidebar"
3. From the window that opens up, add a few panels from the left pane
4. Highlight on any of the panels in the right pane and click on the reorder arrows on the right side
5. Clicking the reorder arrows should move the panel up/down and you should be able to place them wherever you want (top to bottom)
6. Clicking "OK" should also reflect the reordering change in the Sidebar in the browser window

EXPECTED RESULTS
You should be able to reorder panels as you want

reference_cases.title: TC-159
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. From the Sidebar , select "Tabs | Customize Sidebar"
3. From the window that opens up, add a few panels from the left pane
4. Highlight on any of the panels in the right pane and click on the reorder arrows on the right side to move thepanel up/down in the panels list
5. Now, press the CANCEL button

EXPECTED RESULTS
None of the changes that you made (addition of panels or reordering) should get saved and the Sidebar should be the same as before

reference_cases.title: TC-160
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. From the Sidebar, select "Tabs | Customize Sidebar"
3. From the window that opens up, add a few panels from the left panel (or delete a few panels)
4. Highlight any of the panels in the right pane and click on the reorder arrows on the right side to move the panel up/down in the panels list
5. Press the "OK" button to close the window and apply your changes to the Sidebar

EXPECTED RESULTS
Verify that the panel changes and reordering gets reflected in the Sidebar when you press the OK button

reference_cases.title: TC-161
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. Visit any url, say, www.yahoo.com
3. From the Sidebar, select the "What's Related" tab to open it (This tab gets added by default)
4. Observe that a listing of websites is given in the What's Related tab
5. Double click with the mouse on any of the links
6. The selected link should open in the browser window. Try a few more links from the panel

EXPECTED RESULTS
Appropriate links should open in the browser window when clicked from the What's Related panel in the Sidebar

reference_cases.title: TC-162
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. Visit any url, say, www.yahoo.com
3. Bookmark that link using "Bookmarks | Add Current Page"
4. Add theBookmarks panel to the Sidebar using the "Customize Sidebar" option
5. Open the Bookmarks panel in the Sidebar
6. Double click with the mouse on the bookmark that you just added
7. The selected link should open in the browser window. Try a few more bookmarks from the panel

EXPECTED RESULTS
Appropriate bookmarks should open in the browser window when clicked from the Bookmarks panel in the Sidebar

reference_cases.title: TC-163
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. From the Sidebar, select "Tabs | Customize Sidebar"
3. Highlight any panel from the pane on the left and press the "Add" button to add the panel
4. Press "OK" to close the window
5. Now, click on the Tabs button in the Sidebar to open up a menu that lists all panels in the Sidebar
6. The panel that you just added should also be listed (title shown) in the menu listing

EXPECTED RESULTS
Added panel should be listed in the Tabs menu

reference_cases.title: TC-164
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. Click on the "Add" button in the Sidebar to open up a menu that lists all panels in the Sidebar
3. All the panels that are presently in the Sidebar should appear ticked and listed in the menu
4. Now, click on any of the panel titles from the Add menu to remove it from the Sidebar
5. The panel whose title that was just unchecked should not appear in the Sidebar anymore and the panel title should appear unchecked in the Add menu
6. Rechecking the panel title in the Add menu should again make the panel title checked and it should appear in the Sidebar again

EXPECTED RESULTS
Unselecting panels from Add menu should remove the panel from the Sidebar

reference_cases.title: TC-165
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. Click here to open a page to add the bugzilla panel to the Sidebar using javascript
3. Click on the link "Add Bugzilla panel to your sidebar" on the page
4. Press "OK" on the confirm dialog
5. Bugzilla panel should get added to the Sidebar at the bottom
6. Click on the panel to open it

EXPECTED RESULTS
Panel should get added by javascript

technique_rationales.equivalence_partitioning: Cover important input partitions such as default and non-default width, local vs remote panels, and added vs unadded panels.
technique_rationales.boundary_value_analysis: Exercise stated limits like the maximum width of the sidebar being approximately one third of the browser window.
technique_rationales.state_transition: Cover sidebar states (opened/closed via grippy), panel lifecycle states (added, deleted, previewed, customized, reordered), and persistence across window restarts.
technique_rationales.decision_table: Cover condition combinations for saving versus cancelling changes made to panel additions and reordering.
technique_rationales.use_case: Cover end-to-end user flows for browsing panels, previewing, adding, deleting, reordering, and interacting with panel links.
technique_rationales.error_guessing: Explore plausible failures such as attempting to add an already added panel to the sidebar.
